notes: New sites start with a Home page set as the front page, a Blog, a Sample Post, and Log In, Register, Lost Password, User Profile and Dashboard pages.
Settings → Site chooses the user profile and dashboard pages; Settings → Accounts chooses the sign-in pages, where signing in and out leads, and who sees the admin toolbar.
Settings → Roles adds any capability to a role or to one person.
Pages & Posts has a Category column: giving a page a category makes it a post.
Fixed: password reset links now let people choose a new password.
Fixed: shortcodes in page content (sign-in forms, [rwp_login] …) could render nothing.
Page Builder: new Account Form widget; the account pages are built with it.
Search boxes list results as you type and have a Go button.
Theme Editor: choose Left, Center or Right when adding a header or footer block; Right now really sticks to the right.
Pages can hide the header and footer; the header and its menus always stay above page content.
